mapper.select:
select `purchaseinfo`.*, `supplierinfo`.`supplier_name` as drugSupplier, `employeeinfo`.`employee_name` as purchaseMan, `druginfo`.`drug_code` as drugCode, `druginfo`.`drug_name` as drugName from `purchaseinfo` left join `supplierinfo` on `purchaseinfo`.`supplierinfo_id` = `supplierinfo`.id left join `employeeinfo` on `purchaseinfo`.`employeeinfo_id` = `employeeinfo`.id left join `druginfo` on `purchaseinfo`.`druginfo_id` = `druginfo`.id
and `druginfo`.`drug_code` like concat ('%', #{drugCode}, '%')
and `druginfo`.`drug_name` like concat ('%', #{drugName}, '%')
and `supplierinfo`.`supplier_name` like concat ('%', #{drugSupplier}, '%')
and `employeeinfo`.`employee_name` like concat ('%', #{purchaseMan}, '%')
and `purchaseinfo`.`purchase_transport` like concat ('%', #{purchaseTransport}, '%')
